package main import ( "context" "vukatest.local/design" ui "vukatest.local/stateui" ) // Orders is the dialog pair on merged state (one state, §12): the payload // (selected) is a tracked server value, the visibility (open) one state — // written by a method, so synced. tab's only Go read is the mount hook: a // read is a read, so it is synced too. note is never read by Go code: // browser-local, its writes are never sent. type Orders struct { ui.Live rows []Order selected Order open ui.State[bool] tab ui.State[string] note ui.State[string] draft ui.State[string] pop ui.State[bool] // handed to another package's Modal: escape, synced flag ui.State[bool] // handed to Sheet, which only renders it: browser-local gate ui.State[bool] // handed to Gate, whose Check reads its prop: synced } type Order struct { ID int Name string } @ui.Mount func (o *Orders) mount(ctx context.Context) error { if o.tab == "" { o.tab = "all" } return nil } func (o *Orders) Add(name string) { o.rows = append(o.rows, Order{ID: len(o.rows) + 1, Name: name}) } func (o *Orders) Show(i int) { o.selected = o.rows[i] o.open = true } // Park passes draft where the compiler can't follow its reads: escape // means synced. func (o *Orders) Park() { stash(o.draft) } func (o *Orders) Confirm() { if !o.open { return } o.selected = Order{} o.open = false }

{selected.Name}
